mapper.insert: INSERT INTO access_log (log_id, log_time, client_ip, method, uri, query_string, status, duration_ms, user_agent, referer, session_id, error_id, suspicious) VALUES (access_log_seq.NEXTVAL, #{logTime}, #{clientIp}, #{method}, #{uri}, #{queryString}, #{status}, #{durationMs}, #{userAgent}, #{referer}, #{sessionId}, #{errorId}, #{suspicious})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM access_log WHERE suspicious = 'N' AND log_time < SYSTIMESTAMP - NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{days}, 'DAY')
DELETE FROM access_log WHERE suspicious = 'Y' AND log_time < SYSTIMESTAMP - NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{days}, 'DAY')
mapper.select: SELECT log_id, log_time, client_ip, method, uri, query_string, status, duration_ms, user_agent, referer, session_id, error_id, suspicious FROM access_log WHERE suspicious = 'Y' ORDER BY log_time DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
